name: Find YouTube channels in a niche and their verified contact emails with one AI agent and looot

parameters.content:
## YouTube channels in a niche to verified contacts in Google Sheets

### How it works
1. You fill in a form: a niche or keyword, how many channels and a subscriber floor.
2. One AI agent searches YouTube through looot, reads each channel's details, and if the channel links a website, reads it for a business email.
3. Every email it finds is verified.
4. Each channel above the floor lands in Google Sheets with subscribers, country, website, email and email status.

Good for sponsorships, partnerships and creator outreach. One looot credential replaces the Apify and ZeroBounce accounts this flow usually needs. Nothing is sent: you review the list first.

**Cost per run**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: YouTube search $0.00188, channel details $0.00188, a page read from $0.0002, verify $0.00145. 10 channels cost about $0.04 in data. Each call is capped at $0.03 and the agent at 50 steps, so a run can never spend more than $1.50. Model tokens are billed by OpenAI.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- Google Sheets and OpenAI credentials.
- A sheet named Channels with the headers: channel_name, channel_url, subscribers, country, website, email, email_status, about, niche, found_at, run_cost_usd. Set its ID in **Save channels**.
- Self-hosted n8n: set `N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ALLOW_TOOL_USAGE=true` so the agent can use the looot node as a tool.

### Customization
Add a Gmail node after **Save channels** to send a first email to valid addresses.

options.systemMessage:
You build creator outreach lists.
1. job:youtube.search with {"query": "<niche>"}; search again with a related phrase if you need more channels.
2. For each distinct channel: job:youtube.channel with {"url": "<channel url>"} for subscribers, country, description and links.
3. If the description has no email but links a website, read it with job:web.scrape.markdown and look for a contact email.
4. job:people.email.verify with {"email": "..."} for every email you found.
Never invent an email or a subscriber count.

parameters.toolDescription:
Runs one looot data call and returns the run: status, result and actualCost. Every call is capped. Use only these ids and inputs:
- job:youtube.search, input {"query": "..."}: videos and channels.
- job:youtube.channel, input {"url": "https://www.youtube.com/@example"}: channel details and links.
- job:web.scrape.markdown, input {"url": "https://..."}: one page as text.
- job:people.email.verify, input {"email": "..."}: deliverability.
